sources.entry: Orkyo Community - Production scheduling for manufacturing teams — one plan for the machines, people, and tools that run your jobs. (Demo, Source Code) AGPL-3.0 C#/Docker

summary.one_liner: Orkyo Community is a self-hosted, single-tenant production scheduling app that plans machines, people, tools and jobs on a shared visual board, with conflict detection and utilisation tracking.
summary.what_it_does: Provides a shared visual plan for scheduling jobs and requests onto machines, workstations, people, and tools, with drag-and-drop layout editing and real-time allocation status. It flags double-bookings, overloads, capability mismatches and availability clashes before commit, and tracks utilisation to show where capacity is used or wasted. Teams can submit requests that the app matches to available resources, subscribe to schedules via iCal feeds, and manage layouts across multiple sites. QR codes can be placed on resources so a phone scan shows status, and the web app can be added to a phone home screen. An optional AI assistant uses the user's own Anthropic API key and applies suggested changes only after confirmation. It is deployed with Docker Compose via a generator script that creates the secrets and environment file.
use_cases: share a visual production schedule with a team
how_to_run: curl -fsSL <release bundle URL> | tar xz  (download and extract the latest release bundle)
Open the app on port 80 (or the port set with --frontend-port); default login admin@example.com / ChangeMe-Admin-1, password change forced at first login
Upgrade with: docker compose pull && docker compose up -d
notable: Single-tenant Community edition with full data control and no subscription, alongside a managed Orkyo Cloud offering
QR codes on physical resources that open status on a phone (requires HTTPS for camera)
Optional starter datasets for manufacturing or office workspaces
Bring-your-own-key AI assistant where suggested changes need user confirmation
Shared core logic lives in the separate orkyo-foundation repository
caveats: Pre-1.0 and under active development; notifications and reminders are on the roadmap
Community support is best-effort with no SLA or installation support
Explicitly not an ERP, MES or CMMS; it is meant to complement those systems
Depends on the separate orkyo-foundation repository for development builds
